body.name: clipped partial-history importance-weighted estimator
body.construction: For \(0\le k<T\), define \(\widehat\theta_k:=\operatorname{clip}_{[-1,1]}\{(T-k)^{-1}\sum_{t=k+1}^{T}Z_t(k)\}\), with \(Z_t(k)=Y_t\prod_{j=t-k}^{t}\rho_j\) and the zero-cell convention in the definition of \(\rho_t\).
